text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-035 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-035 already tested push notifications with live driver tracking. It shipped with a -7% Contact Rate result and found fatigue after the third push, with a learning to cap pushes at two per order. The proposal does not reference this or incorporate the cap.","evidence_quote":"Send live tracking push notifications when the driver is five minutes away.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-035, explain what is new, and incorporate the learning (cap pushes at two per order). Revisit the expected effect size."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"35% contact reduction stated without source","detail":"The 35% reduction is stated as fact with no source. The prior experiment EXP-035 showed only -7%, so the claim is also inconsistent with existing evidence.","evidence_quote":"This will cut where-is-my-order contacts by 35%.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Cite a source for the 35% figure or replace it with a hedged estimate grounded in EXP-035 results."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Contact Rate not listed as a guardrail","detail":"Notification changes require both Contact Rate and Delivery CSAT as guardrails. Only Delivery CSAT is listed under guardrails. Contact Rate appears only as the success metric.","evidence_quote":"- Delivery CSAT: stop if it falls by more than 0.05.","citations":["guardrail-standards#customer-communication-and-notifications"],"recommendation":"Add Contact Rate as an explicit guardrail with a stop threshold. Consider also tracking opt-outs and fatigue."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days minimum","detail":"The 3-week duration meets the minimum, but the plan's 8-week timeline for the target conflicts with it. More importantly, the plan does not record a sample size or stopping thresholds in line with pre-registration, and the stated MDE of 0.4 per 100 is not tied to the 1.4 per 100 target.","evidence_quote":"Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 0.4 contacts per 100, power 80%.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Record the sample size and align the MDE and stopping rule with the target and guardrail thresholds."}]}
